abstract: Etoposide (VP16) levels were determined by high-performance liquid chromatography assay in plasma, urine, and surgical specimens of patients with choriocarcinoma undergoing surgery after a dose of 100 or 200 mg/m2 given as a 1-hour infusion. The drug disappeared from plasma biexponentially, with a terminal half-life of 4.1 +/- 0.4 hours, an apparent volume of distribution of 9 +/- 1.1 L/m2, and clearance of 21.5 +/- 3.1 ml/minute/m2. Fifty and 740 minutes after the end of VP16 infusion, the drug concentrations in myometrial carcinoma or in normal myometrium were approximately 40%-50% of those in plasma; 25-180 minutes after the end of drug infusion, the concentrations of VP16 in lung metastases amounted to 19%-43% of those in plasma, whereas in normal lung, the concentrations of VP16 were 38%-61% of those in plasma. In subcutaneous tissue, VP16 levels were much lower than in plasma (about 5%-27%). About 50% of VP16 was eliminated in the urine as unchanged drug, glucuronide, or sulfate.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の患者に、100または200 mg/m2を1時間で点滴投与した後、手術を受ける患者の血漿、尿、および手術標本でエトポシド(VP16)レベルを高速液体クロマトグラフィーで測定した。薬物は血漿から二相性に消失し、終末半減期は4.1±0.4時間、見かけの分布容積は9±1.1 L/m2、クリアランスは21.5±3.1 ml/分/m2であった。VP16の点滴終了後50分および740分の時点で、子宮筋層の癌または正常子宮筋層内の薬物濃度は血漿中濃度の約40〜50%であった。点滴終了後25〜180分の時点で、肺転移巣のVP16濃度は血漿中濃度の19〜43%であったのに対し、正常肺では38〜61%であった。皮下組織のVP16濃度は血漿中濃度よりはるかに低かった(約5〜27%)。投与量の約50%が未変化体、グルクロン酸抱合体、または硫酸抱合体として尿中に排泄された。
